mapper.select: SELECT log_date FROM tb_ai_log_analysis_task WHERE id = #{analysisTaskId} AND status = 'SUCCESS'
SELECT id FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task WHERE id > #{afterTaskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, task_no, analysis_task_id, environment, system_code, module_code, provider_code, model_code, status, delivery_status FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task WHERE id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task WHERE id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task task LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ai_task_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting_count FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item WHERE ai_task_id = #{taskId} AND rerun_operation_id IS NULL GROUP BY ai_task_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.ai_task_id = task.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT item.ai_task_id, COUNT(attempt.id) AS total_attempt_count, COALESCE(SUM(attempt.total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item LEFT JOIN tb_ai_log_ai_call_attempt attempt ON attempt.ai_task_item_id = item.id WHERE item.ai_task_id = #{taskId} AND item.rerun_operation_id IS NULL GROUP BY item.ai_task_id ) attempt_summary ON attempt_summary.ai_task_id = task.id SET task.success_count = COALESCE(item_summary.success_count, 0), task.failed_count = COALESCE(item_summary.failed_count, 0), task.total_attempt_count = COALESCE(attempt_summary.total_attempt_count, 0), task.total_token_count = COALESCE(attempt_summary.total_tokens, 0), task.delivery_token = NULL, task.delivery_status = CASE WHEN task.delivery_status = 'DELIVERING' THEN 'WAITING' ELSE task.delivery_status END, task.status = CASE WHEN COALESCE(item_summary.running_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN COALESCE(item_summary.waiting_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'WAITING' WHEN task.preparation_complete = 0 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END, task.finish_time = CASE WHEN task.preparation_complete = 0 THEN NULL WHEN task.total_count = 0 OR (COALESCE(item_summary.running_count, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(item_summary.waiting_count, 0) = 0) THEN COALESCE(task.finish_time, #{now}) ELSE NULL END, task.update_time = #{now} WHERE task.id = #{taskId}
mapper.sql: SELECT task.id AS aiTaskId, task.task_no AS taskNo, task.analysis_task_id AS analysisTaskId, task.environment AS environment, task.system_code AS systemCode, task.module_code AS moduleCode, analysis.log_date AS logDate, task.provider_code AS providerCode, task.model_code AS modelCode, task.status AS status, task.candidate_count AS candidateCount, task.total_count AS totalCount, task.success_count AS successCount, task.failed_count AS failedCount, task.total_attempt_count AS totalAttemptCount, task.total_token_count AS totalTokenCount FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task task JOIN tb_ai_log_analysis_task analysis ON analysis.id = task.analysis_task_id
mapper.select: WHERE task.id > #{afterTaskId} AND task.status IN ('SUCCESS','PARTIAL_SUCCESS','FAILED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item running_item WHERE running_item.ai_task_id = task.id AND running_item.status = 'RUNNING' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_management_operation operation WHERE operation.target_id = CAST(task.id AS CHAR) AND operation.operation_type IN ('AI_GROUP_RERUN','AI_TASK_RERUN') AND operation.status = 'RUNNING' ) AND (task.delivery_status IN ('WAITING','FAILED') OR (task.delivery_status = 'DELIVERING' AND task.delivery_start_time <= #{staleBefore})) ORDER BY task.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task SET delivery_status = 'DELIVERING', delivery_token = #{claimToken}, delivery_attempt_count = delivery_attempt_count + 1, delivery_error_message = NULL, delivery_start_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('SUCCESS','PARTIAL_SUCCESS','FAILED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item running_item WHERE running_item.ai_task_id = #{taskId} AND running_item.status = 'RUNNING' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_management_operation operation WHERE operation.target_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS CHAR) AND operation.operation_type IN ('AI_GROUP_RERUN','AI_TASK_RERUN') AND operation.status = 'RUNNING' ) AND (delivery_status IN ('WAITING','FAILED') OR (delivery_status = 'DELIVERING' AND delivery_start_time <= #{staleBefore}))
